usage: jbus view [-h] [--port PORT] [--since SINCE] [{usage,pace}]

positional arguments:
  {usage,pace}   with usage, count each event the page kept; with pace, give
                 the median seconds from page load to each first action, this
                 week against last

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --port PORT    the one port it listens on
  --since SINCE  count from this time, the user's zone with none (default: 7
                 days ago)
